text: This major mainly studies various communication and information systems in areas such as information acquisition, information transmission and exchange, information networks, information processing, and information control. Its scope is extremely broad, covering numerous fields including telecommunications, broadcasting, television, radar, sonar, navigation, etc., as well as various information systems in military and economic sectors. At the same time, it intersects and permeates with multiple disciplines such as electronic science and technology, computer science and technology, and control theory and technology, giving rise to many new interdisciplinary fields and research directions.
